title: Shopping AI assistants pass the price test but flunk the fine print
title_zh: 让AI帮我买双十一，价格没报错，翻车翻在细节上

image.credit: Photo by Steve Lieman on Unsplash
image.author: Steve Lieman

lead: A reviewer handed four everyday purchases to Taobao's, JD.com's and Douyin's shopping assistants, plus Ant's Lingguang 2.0 agent. Prices checked out; what the bots glossed over was the nature of the goods they recommended.
lead_zh: 一位测评者把四件日常商品交给淘宝、京东和抖音的购物AI，再加上蚂蚁的灵光2.0智能体。价格都对得上，但AI在推荐时没讲清楚商品到底是什么货。
preview: Double 11 promotions now stretch back to mid-October, so the reviewer outsourced the legwork: an iPhone 17 Pro 256GB in silver, AirPods Pro
preview_zh: 如今双十一从十月中旬就开打，测评者干脆把跑腿的活儿外包出去：银色iPhone 17 Pro 256GB、AirPods Pro 3、抽纸和混合坚果，分别交给淘宝AI、京东京言和抖音豆包，还额外加上蚂蚁新推出的灵光2.0。事先手动搜索就暴露了真正的坑：淘宝标价7460元的其实是激活
paragraphs: Double 11 promotions now stretch back to mid-October, so the reviewer outsourced the legwork: an iPhone 17 Pro 256GB in silver, AirPods Pro 3, tissues and mixed nuts were put to Taobao's assistant, JD.com's Jingyan and Douyin's Doubao, with Ant's newly launched Lingguang 2.0 added for good measure. Manual searching beforehand revealed the real hazard: listings priced at 7,460 yuan on Taobao were activated units, while a 7,283-yuan JD.com offer was an unofficial-channel machine.

Taobao's assistant confined itself to its own marketplace and flagged the gap between channel stock and sealed units; Jingyan dug into specifications, spotting a suspicious 588-yuan earbud listing labelled WHALEDAR-OPEN Pro; Doubao simply tallied 7,489, 1,499, 42.9 and 59.9 yuan into 9,090.7 yuan, shaving a tenth of a yuan off the sum. Every price the three quoted proved verifiable on the product pages, yet that alone hardly guarantees the cheapest or wisest purchase.

Lingguang behaved differently. Tasked with tracking the iPhone below 7,500 yuan until 16 November, it checked five times daily and pushed its first alert within two hours, then recalculated after a listing fell from 8,199 to 7,999 yuan, putting the net price near 7,259 yuan. It also cautioned that a circulating 6,999-yuan figure reflected a trade-in deal, not a like-for-like comparison.

The earbuds exposed the weakness. Jingyan recommended a 1,428-yuan listing whose thumbnails read Apple channel stock, and a 1,188.84-yuan Jixi shop that would not ship to the reviewer's region; Taobao's pick carried an authorised-seller badge but showed non-Apple model codes, P63 and P93. Both bots had earlier warned about dubious listings, then recommended equivalents without saying so.
The lesson: AI can cut prices, roughly 740 yuan on the iPhone here, but it must also judge whether an item is worth recommending. Quoting channel stock is fine; passing it off as new is not.
paragraphs_zh: 如今双十一从十月中旬就开打，测评者干脆把跑腿的活儿外包出去：银色iPhone 17 Pro 256GB、AirPods Pro 3、抽纸和混合坚果，分别交给淘宝AI、京东京言和抖音豆包，还额外加上蚂蚁新推出的灵光2.0。事先手动搜索就暴露了真正的坑：淘宝标价7460元的其实是激活机，京东7283元的则是非官方渠道机。
淘宝AI只在自己站内比价，并提醒资源机和原封机的区别；京言会看参数，揪出一款标着WHALEDAR-OPEN Pro的可疑588元耳机；豆包则直接把7489、1499、42.9和59.9元加总成9090.7元，还少算了一毛。三家报的价格在商品页上都能对上，但这并不等于就是最便宜、最值得买的。
灵光的表现不一样。它接下盯价任务：盯住iPhone直到11月16日、低于7500元就通知，每天查五次，不到两小时就发来第一条推送；某店页面价从8199元降到7999元后，它重新算出到手价约7259元，还提醒网上流传的6999元是以旧换新价，不能直接比。
耳机环节暴露了短板。京言推荐的一款1428元商品，缩略图上写着Apple资源机；另一款1188.84元来自京喜店铺，且当前地区不支持销售。淘宝AI推荐的店虽有官方授权标识，却出现P63、P93这类非苹果官方型号。两个AI此前都提醒过可疑商品，轮到自己推荐时却不提了。
结论是：AI确实能帮着省钱，这台iPhone上大约省了740元，但它还得判断什么该不该推荐。报资源机的价没问题，把资源机说成全新才算翻车。
